title: Phenolic acids in Panax ginseng inhibit melanin production through bidirectional regulation of melanin synthase transcription via different signaling pathways.
authors: Liu, Jianzeng; Xu, Xiaohao; Zhou, Jingyuan; Sun, Guang; Li, Zhenzhuo; Zhai, Lu; Wang, Jing; Ma, Rui; Zhao, Daqing; Jiang, Rui; Sun, Liwei
one_liner_zh: 研究人参酚酸通过信号通路双向调控黑色素合成酶转录，仅涉及小分子-蛋白对接，与蛋白质-DNA互作及TF-DNA结合机制无关。
abstract: BACKGROUND: Our previous investigation indicated that the preparation of Panax ginseng Meyer (P. ginseng) inhibited melanogenesis. It comprised salicylic acid (SA), protocatechuic acid (PA), p-coumaric acid (p-CA), vanillic acid (VA), and caffeic acid (CA). In this investigation, the regulatory effects of P. ginseng phenolic acid monomers on melanin production were assessed. METHODS: In vitro and in vivo impact of phenolic acid monomers were assessed. RESULTS: SA, PA, p-CA and VA inhibited tyrosinase (TYR) to reduce melanin production, whereas CA had the opposite effects. SA, PA, p-CA and VA significantly downregulated the melanocortin 1 receptor (MC1R), cycle AMP (cAMP), protein kinase A (PKA), cycle AMP-response element-binding protein (CREB), microphthalmia-associated transcription factor (MITF) pathway, reducing mRNA and protein levels of TYR, tyrosinase-related protein 1 (TYRP1), and TYRP2. Moreover, CA treatment enhanced the cAMP, PKA, and CREB pathways to promote MITF mRNA level and phosphorylation. It also alleviated MITF protein level in alpha-MSH-stimulated B16F10 cells, comparable to untreated B16F10, increasing the expression of phosphorylation glycogen synthase kinase 3beta (p-GSK3beta), beta-catenin, p-ERK/ERK, and p-p38/p38. Furthermore, the GSK3beta inhibitor promoted p-GSK3beta and p-MITF expression, as observed in CA-treated cells. Moreover, p38 and ERK inhibitors inhibited CA-stimulated p-p38/p38, p-ERK/ERK, and p-MITF increase, which had negative binding energies with MC1R, as depicted by molecular docking. CONCLUSION: P. ginseng roots' phenolic acid monomers can safely inhibit melanin production by bidirectionally regulating melanin synthase transcription. Furthermore, they reduced MITF expression via MC1R/cAMP/PKA signaling pathway and enhanced MITF post-translational modification via Wnt/mitogen-activated protein kinase signaling pathway.
abstract_zh: 背景：我们前期的研究表明，人参（Panax ginseng Meyer, P. ginseng）的制备物抑制了黑色素生成。该制备物包含水杨酸（salicylic acid, SA）、原儿茶酸（protocatechuic acid, PA）、对香豆酸（p-coumaric acid, p-CA）、香草酸（vanillic acid, VA）和咖啡酸（caffeic acid, CA）。在本研究中，评估了人参酚酸单体对黑色素生成的调节作用。方法：评估了酚酸单体的体外和体内影响。结果：SA、PA、p-CA和VA抑制了酪氨酸酶（tyrosinase, TYR）以减少黑色素生成，而CA则具有相反的作用。SA、PA、p-CA和VA显著下调了黑皮质素1受体（melanocortin 1 receptor, MC1R）、环磷酸腺苷（cycle AMP, cAMP）、蛋白激酶A（protein kinase A, PKA）、环磷酸腺苷反应元件结合蛋白（cycle AMP-response element-binding protein, CREB）、小眼畸形相关转录因子（microphthalmia-associated transcription factor, MITF）通路，降低了TYR、酪氨酸酶相关蛋白1（tyrosinase-related protein 1, TYRP1）和TYRP2的mRNA和蛋白水平。此外，CA处理增强了cAMP、PKA和CREB通路，以促进MITF mRNA水平和磷酸化。它还缓解了α-MSH刺激的B16F10细胞中MITF蛋白水平，与未处理的B16F10相当，增加了磷酸化糖原合成酶激酶3β（phosphorylation glycogen synthase kinase 3beta, p-GSK3beta）、β-连环蛋白（beta-catenin）、p-ERK/ERK和p-p38/p38的表达。此外，GSK3beta抑制剂促进了p-GSK3beta和p-MITF的表达，正如在CA处理的细胞中所观察到的。此外，p38和ERK抑制剂抑制了CA刺激的p-p38/p38、p-ERK/ERK和p-MITF的增加，这些与MC1R具有负结合能，如分子对接所示。结论：人参根部的酚酸单体可以通过双向调节黑色素合酶转录来安全地抑制黑色素生成。此外，它们通过MC1R/cAMP/PKA信号通路减少了MITF表达，并通过Wnt/丝裂原活化蛋白激酶信号通路增强了MITF的翻译后修饰。
